powers.name: Sealord
powers.summary: Channel energy as a cleric of your Druid level 3 + Charisma modifier times per day, only to heal or command creatures with the aquatic or water subtype.

powers.name: Seastrike
powers.summary: Use natural and manufactured weapons underwater as with continuous freedom of movement; throw a weapon underwater as a standard action without normal penalties, and it returns when the target is in or under water.
